After escaping her prison on [[Koba]], Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after many years of captivity and was promoted immediately to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Master Yaddle then constructed an orange-bladed '''lightsaber''' which she wielded until her death on [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].

==History==
After constructing her lightsaber, Master Yaddle would rarely need to use her weapon, as she would remain on Coruscant in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. In some cases, she would use it, like in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] on a [[Mission to Asmeru|mission]] to the planet of [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] and [[Vergere]]. She used her lightsaber against the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] terrorists, emerging victorious.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Yaddle traveled to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] with fellow Council members [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], Ki-Adi-Mundi, [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]. [[Hutar Zash]] would betray his friend Even Piell and seek to appease the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]]. Master Yaddle and her comrades bravely fought against the Red Iaro members, emerging victorious.

Master Yaddle then participated on a mission to [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]], along with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. There, they confronted [[Granta Omega]], the son of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] former apprentice [[Xanatos]]. Yaddle sacrificed herself to save the people of Mawan.
